text: A captain shares his plan. Everyone says... great idea! Nobody mentions the weak defence... until match day.

text: His plans came out... his people pushed back... he gave in. Done one day... undone the next.

text: Shutting people out isn't the answer. Pick wise people... ask them everything... then decide yourself.

text: Reward whoever brings bad news... and bad news stops hiding.
